text: {"lessons":["Avoid selling stocks at a loss only to buy them back soon after at higher prices; reassess the investment case before re-entering.","Do not chase a stock after taking a profit: I sold Stock E, then bought it again at a higher price, so I should require a clear reason to re-enter.","Judge decisions by the portfolio’s long-term results, not by a few profitable sales or short-term account gains; keep position sizes and cash use deliberate."]}
